name: lao-mineral-map-ccop
title: Lao PDR 1:1M Mineral Map (CCOP GSi, federated WMS)
notes: Mineral occurrences of Lao PDR from the LAO DOM 1:1,000,000 Mineral Map, published by the CCOP Geoinformation Sharing Infrastructure (ccop-gsi.org) as a dynamic WMS (MapServer). This record only points at the partner service: AMConnect does not host the data. The WMS is queryable (GetFeatureInfo as text/html, GML or text/plain), has a legend, but exposes no WFS/WCS, so the layer is view-only in AMConnect.

resources.name: Mineral occurrences of Lao PDR (CCOP WMS)
resources.description: WMS 1.3.0 endpoint on ccop-gsi.org (MapServer). Layer M_portal_maps_min_occur_lao_table_table1_20170907164402_k1E, queryable. No CORS headers, so browser-side GetFeatureInfo falls back to a link.
